content:
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy for service `query-router`.

deploy-bot: Helm chart upgrade: `query-router-chart` 3.4.0 -> 3.5.0

deploy-bot: Canary set: 5% traffic, 2 pods, values override file: `prod/canary-values.yaml`

Maya R: Heads up — noticed `CANARY_SECRET` isn't present in prod secrets after templating.

Jordan P: Canary pods failing readiness: 502 gateway, logs show app error `MissingSecretError: CANARY_SECRET`.

sre-bot: Alert: canary pod crashloop in prod/query-router-c-2 (oom:false) — reason: Init failed, secret mount failed

Anya K: Does 3.5.0 change secret name? I remember we switched to `query-router-secret-v2` in the chart. If so, values override didn't set `secretName`.

Maya R: Yep — chart default is `query-router-secret-v2` but our prod secret is `query-router-secret` (legacy). Override file didn't include `secretName`.

Priya (release-manager): Change window note: payroll batch starts in 50m — prefer hotpatch now instead of full rollback if it's safe.

Liam S: Options:
- rollback chart to 3.4.0 (fast): `helm rollback query-router RELEASE_REV --namespace prod`
- hotpatch values and redeploy canary: update secret or set `secretName` via `helm upgrade` with `--reuse-values --set config.secretName=query-router-secret`

Anya K: Hotpatch looks safer — minimal blast radius. We can create a compatibility secret alias and patch values. I'm for hotpatch and pinning.

Maya R: I'll create a compatibility secret with the expected key `CANARY_SECRET` containing the same data as current secret.

Maya R: Running:
```
kubectl -n prod create secret generic query-router-secret-v2 --from-literal=CANARY_SECRET=$(kubectl -n prod get secret query-router-secret -o jsonpath='{.data.CANARY_SECRET}')
```

Jordan P: After secret added, run helm upgrade with reuse-values:
```
helm upgrade query-router ./charts/query-router-chart \
  --namespace prod \
  --reuse-values \
  --set image.tag=3.5.0-patch1 \
  --set config.secretName=query-router-secret-v2
```

sre-bot: Starting post-deploy smoke checks: readiness, latency p95, 5xx rate, canary logs tail

Priya (release-manager): Also set a chart pin for the release so the autoscaling doesn't pick latest: add `chartVersion: 3.5.0-patch1` to release metadata and note in release notes.

Liam S: I'll update release docs and add a rollback playbook snippet.

deploy-bot: Hotpatch applied to canary at 1769308100 — monitoring

sre-bot: Canary healthy after 12m, readiness 100%, 5xx 0.0%, p95 latency within SLO :thumbsup:

Priya (release-manager): OK to promote to full rollout at +1h if no regressions. I'll open the release window ticket.

Maya R: Leaving a note in the values repo: pinned `chartVersion: 3.5.0-patch1` and added `secretName` override. (PR: https://git.redwood/s/release/1234)

Jordan P: Nice work — set `:shipit:` reaction on the PR once CI passes.

Anya K: Postmortem item: add a lint check to flag secret name drift between chart defaults and infra secrets.

deploy-bot: Marking thread resolved.
